title: 2025: effective inertia can be engineered down to zero

statements.text: Effective mass $m_{\mathrm{eff}} = \eta m_0$ can be tuned over $\eta \in [0, \infty)$ by controlling invariants of the temporal flow, with a stable, causal limit $\eta \to 0$ and an engineering roadmap for inertial control.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: I prove the stability and causality conditions that permit η → 0 without pathologies, and I outline falsifiable benchtop experiments.
gives an engineering roadmap for inertial control.
